heading: One person, writing the news I wish existed.
body:
I'm a Political Science & Philosophy student at the University of Ottawa — and I work inside the rooms where policy actually gets made, on Parliament Hill and with the Young Liberals of Canada. The news gets written *about* my generation, rarely for us, and almost never by someone who has to live with the results.

So this is my version: original writing on the policy, politics, climate, and culture shaping us — from someone who's actually in the room, in plain language, with receipts.
closer: Independent. No VC, no algorithm, no team of ghostwriters. Just me.
quote: I'm not a demographic to be solved. Neither are you. We're the people who have to actually live in the world these decisions build — so we should be the ones writing about it.
